recoveryObligations.obligation: GET/POST paths use actorId of the original owner (9), never current ADMIN (7).
GET/POST paths retain the exact original action; no fallback action inferred from current page.
GET/POST paths retain uuidOriginal; resolver UUID is a separate identity.
Metadata-only original terna survives reload and allows server consultation without original A payload.
Real ADMIN with FISCAL_LEER can recover while perfiles/conciliacion/preparacionE5 are all false.
ADMIN lacking FISCAL_LEER cannot read or resolve recovery.
CONTADOR F with FISCAL_LEER cannot read or resolve recovery.
E11 OFF never sends recovery GET/POST and does not discard original metadata.
PENDIENTE is absence observed, not proof of rollback; retain original terna and block business replacement.
CONFIRMADA with null resolucionId does not release; explicit ADMIN resolution remains necessary.
Exact CONFIRMADA with authoritative resolution id/date can release that original terna.
Exact CERRADA_SIN_EFECTO with authoritative resolution id/date can release without reissuing business.
404 NO_ENCONTRADO does not discard/quarantine-clear or infer rollback.
Timeout/503/403 preserve original metadata; no optimistic local resolution.
Schema-valid foreign actorId cannot release or show a successful resolution.
Schema-valid foreign accion cannot release or show a successful resolution.
Schema-valid foreign uuidOriginal cannot release or show a successful resolution.
Invalid revision is not valid authoritative state and cannot feed a resolution request.
Missing/malformed resolution identity never releases metadata.
Missing/invalid resolution timestamp never presents audited terminal completion.
Release only the exact actor/action/original-UUID; preserve other actors/actions even sharing original UUID.
Resolution sends only uuid/revisionEsperada/identidadVersion/motivo, no original A/business payload.
ADMIN resolution uses its own UUID, not uuidOriginal; no new business intention is synthesized.
Nonempty reviewed motive is required; do not silently fabricate it.
Revalidate real ADMIN/FISCAL_LEER and bind identidadVersion to fresh ADMIN permisosVersion before POST.
Bind revisionEsperada to GET of the exact original terna; changed revision requires renewed review.
Concurrent confirm clicks cannot submit duplicate resolver mutations.
Only exact authoritative audited CONFIRMADA/CERRADA_SIN_EFECTO releases the original terna.
Even a successful transport with PENDIENTE or unaudited CONFIRMADA cannot release.
Lost resolution response preserves resolver UUID/body for authorized ADMIN and original terna.
409 RESULTADO_CONFIRMADO_NO_CONSULTABLE and 503 RESULTADO_INCIERTO preserve resolver intent without financial disclosure.
Authorized replay sends exactly the same resolver UUID/body to the same original-terna path.
Replay rejection does not prove original resolution rollback; preserve recovery and require authority.
REVISION_OBSOLETA triggers fresh exact GET; PENDIENTE does not release or silently create another resolver UUID.
After REVISION_OBSOLETA, exact authoritative audited terminal GET can release original recovery.
After lost POST response, authoritative exact GET CONFIRMADA releases without replaying money.
After lost POST response, authoritative exact GET CERRADA_SIN_EFECTO releases without business retry.
Resolver UUID is never quarantined as a new original business operation; continue consulting original terna.
Loss of ADMIN authorization removes resolver body/private details, preserves only original recovery metadata.
A different authorized ADMIN can consult/resolve the original owner namespace without old resolver/business body.
Marker missing original actor/action/UUID is blocked explicitly, not assigned current ADMIN or discarded as resolved.
Recovery GET/resolution only; never call original profile/snapshot/decision/preparation mutations to unblock.
